sourceAdaptations: Original Canvas engine and math retained, not a screenshot/static substitute. Host toolbar/native controls are authored isolation shell, not original dat.GUI/Vue documentation app.
Local decorative/math demonstration only, no microphone/audio-analysis/recognition/AI/backend. No audio permissions, data uploads, remote resources or binary packaging.
Private component-owned canvas, DPR fixed1 and measured width capped900px, no body background mutation. Zero-size defers construction and pauses existing loop; positive resize recovers.
Pause/resume preserves desired playback and parameter/model state; hidden stops draw loop, visible respects user pause/reduced choice. Restart explicitly recreates a fresh original model.

Reduced draws one real original frame with no RAF remaining. Canvas null context/startup/render errors and explicit contextlost events dispose and show real unavailable state. Event/observer ownership and terminal exit prevent stale controls from restoring work.
Uses original official ios9 fluorescent curve style. Classic source remains required local module but UI only demonstrates ios9; iOS13 WIP is not included.

Original curve files byte-identical. index.ts factors original clear/lerp/draw/phase body into drawOnce, guards RAF by run and catches late errors via onError. Removed phase-reset on pause/start so pause does not reset phase.

Host setAmplitude/setSpeed retained for running interpolation; paused/reduced inputs snap requested amplitude/speed; single-frame drawing is gated to visible positive-size canvas, so hidden/zero-size inputs preserve parameters without draw.
Original ios9 curve spawn uses Date.now; hidden stops rendering, but wall-clock spawning can refresh when resumed. Do not claim a deterministic simulation time freeze.
canvasTest: Canvas draw-command recorder and explicit RAF/bounds/ResizeObserver stubs; no pixels rendered
